image_description: A high-angle, cluttered shot of a white table surface covered in various hair styling tools and accessories. Visible items include multiple black cylindrical aerosol cans (likely hairspray), hairbrushes, combs, clips, a small mirror, and packaging. An orange plastic bin is visible in the upper right background. The scene appears to be a collection of beauty supplies laid out for display or organization.
